paragraphs: The Cible Retour à l'Emploi team is proud to help job seekers better understand the labour market, support them throughout their process, and contribute to achieving their goals.

For more than 20 years, we have supported Montrealers of all education levels, backgrounds, and fields of activity. Through our services, we have helped improve the circumstances of thousands of families and individuals. Cible Retour à l'Emploi is one of 91 employment counselling centres that are members of AXTRA, which together help more than 80,000 people find their path every year in Quebec.
We are a non-profit organization that supports you in your efforts, putting forward respect, empathy, responsibility, and collaboration.
